title: America’s Downtowns Need More Than Offices
summary: America's office real estate bust is forcing cities to rethink their downtowns. Bloomberg Opinion's Justin Fox argues that converting offices into homes and building mixed-use neighborhoods could offer a path to revival.

title: OpenAI Arrest Raises AI Espionage Concerns
summary: An OpenAI engineer was arrested over allegations of planting a covert recording device in an executive conference room, highlighting concerns about protecting sensitive AI technology. The discussion also covers the shift of AI training work toward highly skilled experts.

title: Accenture looks to sell Chinese operations for up to $1.5bn
summary: Accenture is looking to sell its Chinese operations for up to $1.5bn. The shares of the world's largest IT consultancy have fluctuated on questions about AI's impact.

title: Microsoft Scraps UK Data Center Deal With Nscale, Telegraph Says
summary: Microsoft has pulled out of a UK data center deal with neocloud Nscale, per the Telegraph, at a critical moment for the startup's IPO hopes.

title: ‘Tulum 3.0’: Inversionistas apuestan por el turismo de lujo y exclusividad ante la caída de visitantes
summary: American Airlines es la tercera gran aerolínea en recortar vuelos a Tulum mientras cae el turismo. Los inversionistas buscan devolver al destino su perfil de lujo y exclusividad.

title: America’s $10tn AI infrastructure boom is starting to fray
summary: America's $10tn AI infrastructure boom is starting to fray as a vast bet on the technology runs into the unforgiving economics of the physical world.

title: Anthropic turns to lawyers to help AI agents strike deals
summary: Las tecnológicas enfrentan las reglas de la negociación cuando las máquinas actúan en nombre de las personas. El FT reporta que Anthropic recurre a abogados para ayudar a que los agentes de IA cierren acuerdos.

title: Global economy set for AI-driven surge, FT survey suggests
summary: A poll of 94 economists suggests an AI-driven surge in the global economy, with benefits reaching well beyond the US and China.

title: AI Trade Reversal Pierces Asia’s Star Picks-and-Shovels Stocks
summary: A deepening selloff in US tech stocks exposes a vulnerability in Asia's AI trade: rising financing costs could choke off the spending that sustains the boom and threaten supply-chain earnings.

title: CoreWeave Woes Risk Shutting Down AI Junk Market: Credit Weekly
summary: Junk bond buyers are increasingly freezing out tech startups seeking financing as CoreWeave's troubles raise questions about how AI companies will fund themselves.

title: DeepSeek Pushes Out Updated AI Model It Says Is Faster, Leaner
summary: DeepSeek released an updated AI model it says is faster and leaner, stepping up its challenge to Anthropic, OpenAI and domestic rivals such as Moonshot Kimi and Z.ai.

title: AI Selloff Tests Investor Confidence
summary: Barry Ritholtz of Ritholtz Wealth says AI remains transformational, but investors struggle to identify eventual winners and losers. He discusses CoreWeave's selloff, AI financing concerns and valuations.

title: La IA puede acelerar el PIB mundial, pero también desatar turbulencias financieras, dice el FMI
summary: La directora del FMI, Kristalina Georgieva, advierte que la IA puede acelerar el crecimiento mundial, pero también generar riesgos financieros, transformar el mercado laboral y ampliar brechas entre países. Pide prepararse para gestionar sus efectos.

title: Nu México debuta como banco ante la CNBV con menor morosidad que otros neobancos
summary: Nu México debuta como banco ante la CNBV, con una morosidad menor que la de otros neobancos. El dato posiciona al neobanco frente a la banca tradicional y a otros jugadores digitales en crédito.

title: S&P 500 cae y el Nasdaq 100 sufre su mayor caída semanal desde 2025 ante dudas sobre la IA
summary: Wall Street profundizó sus pérdidas por dudas sobre la rentabilidad de la inversión en IA y el repunte del petróleo, que reavivó preocupaciones inflacionarias y presionó el mercado de bonos. El S&P 500 cayó 1,09%.

title: It’s not just Commerzbank: Italians are eating up German business
summary: The Economist argues UniCredit's takeover of Commerzbank is only the start, as Italian firms increasingly buy up German businesses.

title: Bank of America propone una nueva estrategia para invertir y superar al portafolio 60/40
summary: Bank of America propone una nueva distribución de inversiones para superar al portafolio tradicional 60/40, buscando mayor rentabilidad sin elevar la volatilidad. La estrategia clásica de acciones y bonos enfrenta cuestionamientos en Wall Street.
